title: Contact card with vCard download
when: The user wants a card for a person with photo, role and contact links, and a button to save the contact.
prompt:
Goal: A compact contact card with working tel and mailto links and a Save contact button that downloads a valid .vcf file.
Steps:
1. <article aria-labelledby="card-name"> with an img (alt with the name, width, height), an h2 name, the role, and <address> holding tel, mailto and the street text.
2. Save contact is <button type="button"> that builds vCard lines: BEGIN:VCARD, VERSION:3.0, N, FN, ORG, TITLE, TEL, EMAIL, END:VCARD, joined with \r\n.
3. Escape commas, semicolons and backslashes in values with a backslash.
4. Download via new Blob([text], { type: "text/vcard" }), an anchor with download="name.vcf", then URL.revokeObjectURL.
5. Card: max-width 22rem, a 96 px round photo with object-fit: cover.
Quality bar:
- Phone in international format in the tel link.
- Links have visible text, not only icons.
- The card prints cleanly.
Pitfalls:
- Unescaped commas that break the vCard fields.
- A photo without dimensions shifting the layout.
- Contact info only inside an image.
Verify:
- [ ] The photo has alt, width and height.
- [ ] tel and mailto links work.
- [ ] The .vcf opens with all fields.
- [ ] The button has type="button".
Output: Card markup, card.css and vcard.js.

examples.input: cartao de visita digital com botao salvar contato
examples.output: article with photo, name, role, tel and mailto, Save contact downloads ana-lima.vcf with escaped fields
